results.title: Solar PV System Design Engineer – Off-Grid Residential
results.description_snippet: Need an engineer to design a 10kW off-grid solar system including load analysis, panel layout, battery sizing, and single-line diagram...

proposal.cover_letter: Your off-grid 10kW system project is exactly the kind of challenge I specialize in. I've designed over 40 residential off-grid systems using PVsyst and HOMER Pro, always starting with a granular load analysis before sizing panels and battery banks. For a system at this scale I'd deliver: (1) a complete load audit and sizing report, (2) PVsyst simulation outputs with P50/P90 yield estimates, (3) a code-compliant single-line diagram ready for AHJ submission, and (4) a BOM with three sourcing options at different price tiers. Happy to walk you through a similar completed project on a call — when works for you?

results.title: Renewable Energy Consultant – Utility-Scale Solar Feasibility Study
results.description_snippet: We need a consultant to produce a feasibility study for a 5MW ground-mount solar farm in Queensland. Must include yield analysis, grid connection review, and financial model...

proposal.cover_letter: Utility-scale feasibility is my core practice — I've delivered studies for projects from 1MW to 50MW across three continents. For your Queensland 5MW site I'd structure the engagement in three phases: (1) resource and yield analysis via PVsyst with TMY3 data and shading from satellite DSM, (2) DNSP grid connection pre-assessment against Energex/Ergon requirements, and (3) a 25-year DCF model with sensitivity tables on DSCR, IRR, and LCOE. Deliverable is a bankable-grade report. I can share a redacted comparable study on request.

results.title: Photovoltaic Engineer – Commercial Rooftop System Review
results.description_snippet: Looking for a PV engineer to peer-review existing design documents for a 250kW commercial rooftop installation. Must verify structural loading assumptions and electrical design...

proposal.cover_letter: Peer review is a discipline in itself — I approach it as a fresh-eyes audit rather than a rubber stamp. For a 250kW commercial rooftop I'd systematically check: dead/live/snow/wind loading against the structural drawings and local NBCC requirements, NEC 690 compliance on string sizing, OCPD, and disconnects, inverter selection and clipping analysis, and conduit fill and wire sizing. You'll get a marked-up redline PDF plus a structured findings report with severity ratings (critical / major / minor). Turnaround is typically 3–4 business days for a project this size.
